newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil slips in thin activity, prems hold.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil slips in thin activity, prems hold.

text.p: NWE gas oil was a touch weaker on Monday as weaker IPE futures shaved off outright prices despite holding premiums.
March IPE gas oil traded thinly falling towards the end of the afternoon to close 75 cents down at $177.50 a tonne.
IP week in London has affected market liquidity with numerous players away from their desks.
Second half February barges traded between March IPE +$1-2 fob ARA, steady on Friday's levels. There was almost no interest for first half March material.
Cargoes were even more thinly discussed.
FOD was pegged around March IPE +$2-4 cif NWE for second half February, but attracting few takers.
EN590 cargoes were assessed around March IPE +$18 cif NWE.
